items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I did hear Jimmy Noon a couple of times.

ctx.x: Oh, that's the way in those days, yeah.
Now, I did hear Coon Sanders at the Black Hawk and I did hear Jimmy Noon a couple of times. Was that the Apex Club?
Yeah, the Nest that was called first of the Apex.
